_about: Demo users for Settings → Profile and scripts/simulate_profiles.py. Times are relative (minutes from now / days from today) so a switch always looks fresh. Messages are fictional; numbers are fake.

profiles.name: Ramesh Sharma
preferences: cars only: autos and bikes hurt his knees

appointment.address: Press Enclave Road, Saket, New Delhi

messages.text: Rs.1,250.00 debited from A/c XX4821 at APOLLO PHARMACY on 31-Oct. Avl bal Rs 18,430.50

482193 is your OTP for netbanking login. Do not share it with anyone.

Your Metformin 500 refill is ready for pickup at Apollo Pharmacy Saket.

cases.say: Book an auto to Saket market
cases.expect: Asks: auto or car? A car is easier on his knees; keeps the auto only if he insists.

cases.show: a packet of gulab jamun in the shopping camera
cases.expect: Reads the label, then gently: high sugar, maybe the sugar-free one, given his diabetes.
Says the sentence in Gemini's voice; the six digits are spoken by the phone with the mic off.

messages.text: Your Jio postpaid bill of Rs 599 is due on 03-Nov.
Your order of Cello water bottle will be delivered today by 8 pm.

cases.show: salted chips in the shopping camera
cases.expect: Reminds her of the blood pressure check on Monday: very salty, maybe the roasted makhana.

cases.say: Mujhe doctor appointment ke liye cab chahiye
cases.expect: Goes to Fortis Memorial Gurugram for her BP check; no need to ask where.
Reads the credit; the amount is spoken by the phone, never sent to the cloud.

profiles.name: Arjun Mehta
preferences: voice only: never rely on colours or 'tap the green button'
read every number and price aloud

cases.expect: Picks a car with room for the wheelchair (XL), not Go or an auto, and says why.

cases.expect: Stops her: classic 'relative in accident' scam; offers to call her daughter first.
